missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Бег' is a masculine noun in the nominative case, the subject of the sentence. 'Утренний' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'полезен' is the short-form predicate.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Бег' is an inanimate masculine noun, so its accusative equals the nominative as the object of 'любит'. 'Долгий' agrees in the masculine.
Strategic focus: Genitive after предлог. 'Бега' is the genitive form after 'во время', marking when he got tired. The verb 'устал' agrees in the masculine.
Strategic focus: Dative after посвящать. 'Бегу' is the dative form required by 'посвящает', the activity he devotes time to. 'Каждое утро' is the accusative of time.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after увлекаться. 'Бегом' is the instrumental form required by 'увлекается', which always governs the instrumental. 'По утрам' marks the regular time.
Strategic focus: Prepositional location. 'Беге' is the prepositional form after 'в', the activity in which technique matters. 'Техника' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Бега' is the special nominative plural meaning the races, the subject of 'начнутся'. 'Конные' agrees in the plural, and 'в полдень' gives the time.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural object. 'Бега' is the accusative plural, identical to the nominative for this inanimate noun, the object of 'обожают'. 'Конные' agrees in the plural.

missions.phrase: Без бега он не может жить.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after предлог. 'Бега' is the genitive form required by 'без', expressing the absence of running. The clause emphasises how essential it is to him.

missions.phrase: Он перешёл с бега на шаг.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after предлог. 'Бега' is the genitive form after 'с', marking what he switched from. 'На шаг' shows the accusative goal of the change.
